Topology [built]
graph of the SimBench lines, weight = length (km); transformers and switches 0
dij = shortest-path length · Lij = lines on that path
zones = feeders · a DSO trade runs from the participant to the transformer busbar (M-31)

div.div:
Edge flows, every step [to build]
Fe = Σ qij / Δt over the trades whose path Lij uses line e
from 0 each step (M-35), all three stages (M-36), DSO trades to the transformer (M-31)
opposite trades add up, as in P1 §3.5.3; untraded energy and the network's own loads are not seen

div.div:
Edge capacity [decision]
P1: Ce = Ctot · (1/ℓe) / Σk (1/ℓk), ℓ = line length
Ctot = Σ line ratings (P1 gives none; the release uses 1e6 kW)
variant: Ce = rating of line e

div.div:
What arm A gives the fees
Ct = max over e ∈ Lij of loadinge / 100, capped at 1 [built]
Vdrop = |Va − Vb| measured between the trade's two buses; a DSO trade: participant's bus vs transformer busbar [proposed]
now: fvolt · dij, as in arm B

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 460px; height: 1px; padding-top: 10000px; margin-left: 10000px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
What both arms give the fees
lij = κ · dij · qij (P1 eq. 18), κ = 0.03 per km [decision] (M-41); recorded, not deducted from the delivered energy
same zone: both ends on one feeder (M-33, M-34)
Bgrid: offered minus asked energy before stage 3 (P1 eq. 20), for the imbalance fee of DSO trades (M-30)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 230, 204), rgb(54, 33, 10)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 460px; height: 1px; padding-top: 10000px; margin-left: 10000px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
What arm B gives the fees
Ct = max over e ∈ Lij of Fe / Ce, capped at 1 (P1 eq. 19) [to build]
Vdrop = fvolt · dij (P1 eq. 8f), fvolt = 0.15 per km [built]
independent of load and of the measured voltages

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1500px; height: 1px; padding-top: 10000px; margin-left: 10000px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
DSO fees per trade, P1 eq. 8 [built] (same formulas and factors in both arms; only Ct and Vdrop come from the arm)
Fcong = 0.5 · (Ct − 0.8) · q · p if Ct > 0.8 · Fthermal = min((Ct − 0.2) / 0.8, 0.3) · q · p if Ct > 0.2 (M-32)
Fvolt = min(Vdrop, 0.05) · q · p · Ftrans = lij · p (M-28) · Fzone = −0.15 · q · p in one zone · Fimb for DSO trades that worsen Bgrid
peer trades: split 50/50 between buyer and seller; DSO trades: paid by the participant

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 460px; height: 1px; padding-top: 10000px; margin-left: 10000px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Reward [built]
ri = (profiti − putility · deferred demandi) / scale
profit includes the participant's fees: the only way the grid method reaches learning

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(238, 243, 251), rgb(25, 29, 36)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1500px; height: 1px; padding-top: 10000px; margin-left: 10000px;

div.div:
Measurement, both arms [proposed]: the AC power flow of arm A runs in arm B too and is recorded there, but sets no fee
grid: peak line loading, overload hours, voltage-band violations, line and transformer losses, import / export · market: fees per part, peer-to-peer share, prices, profits
arm B only: its Ct next to the measured loading of the same lines (how well the paper's signal follows the physics)
